description: Current gas price tiers (high/average/low) with estimated confirmation times, MEV-protection fee and native token USD price. Agents use this to set optimal priority fees for snipe transactions. Covers Solana, Base, BSC and Ethereum. 0.05 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: gmgn_gas_price
